jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Vi söker just nu en kvalificerad fritidsledare till vårt fritidsteam. Som fritidsledare på IES Sigtuna kommer du att arbeta med att leverera omsorg och stöd före och efter skoltid till våra elever i F-6 och ansvara för att undervisa i enlighet med den nationella fritidsläroplanen. Förutom att utföra ovanstående uppgifter kommer du också att ansvara för att ge specialiserat stöd till eleverna baserat på deras individuella behov. Vi söker personal som, precis som vi, tror på att ge eleverna möjlighet att förverkliga sin fulla potential, oavsett bakgrund. Du måste också vara kunnig och passionerad när det gäller utbildning och barn. Du ska ha verktygen för att skapa en lugn miljö och kunna inspirera eleverna. 

Du ingår i en arbetsgrupp som tillsammans planerar och utvecklar fritidsverksamheten. Du förstår vikten av att samarbeta med dina kollegor, upprätthålla rutiner och regler, se möjligheter, ta stort eget ansvar samt ha ett vänligt och respektfullt bemötande mot alla du möter i arbetet. Vidare måste du ha en god förmåga att skapa positiva relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och personal. Ytterligare egenskaper vi söker är att du kan arbeta strukturerat, men samtidigt vågar vara flexibel. Förmågan att leda i grupp för att motivera och skapa delaktighet är oerhört viktig. Du arbetar bra i team, men kan också ta egna initiativ.

Vi sätter barnet i centrum under hela skoldagen. Vi har en positiv inställning till elevers och kollegors förmågor och vi reflekterar ständigt över hur vi som vuxna tillsammans kan påverka den undervisning vi bedriver i en positiv riktning.

Den här personen bör vara behörig inom något av följande områden:

- Fritidspedagog
- Fritidsledare
- Fritidslärare
- Lärare mot fritidshemmet

IES Sigtuna är en internationell skolmiljö, därför är flytande kunskaper i både engelska och svenska meriterande.

Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna är belägen i ett nybyggt grönområde i Sigtuna kommun och ståtar med den historiska och vackra staden Sigtuna. IES Sigtuna är en skola där varje elev blir sedd och hörd och där du får möjlighet att göra skillnad i deras liv.

Internationella Engelska Skolan är en verkligt internationell skola. Vi har personal och elever från hela världen som bidrar till en dynamisk internationell atmosfär. Våra skolor är tvåspråkiga med upp till 50% av undervisningen på engelska och följer den svenska nationella läroplanen.

Ansök nu och se till att ladda upp ditt CV och ditt personliga brev på vår IES Careers-webbplats.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

jobs.occupation: Teacher Librarian, Bladins International School of Malmö
jobs.description:
At Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM), we are looking for an enthusiastic Teacher Librarian to join our Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) in January 2027.
If you are passionate about inspiring a love of reading, developing information literacy and supporting learning in an international school, we would love to hear from you.
About Bladins International School of Malmö
BISM is an IB Continuum School in central Malmö, offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) to approximately 360 students from diverse nationalities and cultures.
As part of Bladins Foundation, a non-profit educational organisation, we provide a supportive, internationally minded learning environment where students grow into knowledgeable, caring and responsible global citizens.
The Role
As Teacher Librarian, you will promote reading, inquiry-based learning and students' research, information literacy and critical thinking skills across PYP and MYP.
BISM has two dedicated libraries, one for PYP and one for MYP. You will develop these as welcoming and inclusive learning spaces and work closely with teachers to support learning across the curriculum.
Key responsibilities include:

Developing and managing both school libraries and their print and digital collections

Promoting reading for pleasure through library lessons, initiatives and events

Teaching information literacy, research skills, digital literacy and critical thinking

Collaborating with teachers to support PYP units of inquiry and MYP subjects, with awareness of the curriculum across MYP

Supporting students' Approaches to Learning (ATL) skills, including ethical use of information, referencing and academic integrity

Ensuring resources reflect the school's international, multilingual community and diverse learning needs

Building positive relationships with students, colleagues and families and engaging with the wider BISM community

Contributing to school development and a welcoming library environment

Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a qualified, proactive Teacher Librarian with a passion for literacy and student learning.
You are:

Qualified in library and information science, preferably with school library experience

Experienced in supporting children's and young people's reading, research and information literacy

Knowledgeable about children's and young adult literature and able to inspire readers of different ages

Skilled in inquiry-based learning and collaboration with classroom and subject teachers

Confident using digital library systems, educational technology and online resources

Inclusive, organised and able to manage library activities independently

A positive communicator and collaborative member of an international team

Committed to professional development

Experience with the International Baccalaureate (IB), particularly PYP and/or MYP, is an advantage. Understanding the IB philosophy, Learner Profile and Approaches to Learning (ATL) is highly valued.
As English is the school's working language, professional spoken and written English is required.
Why Join BISM?
At BISM, you will join a welcoming international community committed to students, colleagues and learning. We offer supportive colleagues, professional development, an IB learning environment and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference to students' development.
Employment Information
Position: Teacher Librarian  Employment type: Permanent employment, with a six-month probationary period  Working hours: Part-time (60%)  Start date: January 2027
Application
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. Please apply by 30 November 2026.
For more information, contact:
Kumari Nevill, Primary School Principal Kumari.nevill@bladins.se
We look forward to welcoming a colleague who shares our commitment to high-quality education, collaboration and student success.

Reports to: Middle School Principal
Our vision
To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.
Duties and Responsibilities: 
Teaching MYP 1 - Grade 6 to MYP 4 - Grade 9, and Primary Grades 4-5 French language acquisition.
Developing materials appropriate for classes with a wide range of abilities.
Contributing to the development and implementation of the curriculum.
Creating and implementing lessons for differentiated skill levels in a classroom.  
Communicating regularly with parents. 
Being an active and contributing member of the school’s faculty. 
Participating in the full range of professional activities in the school. 
Actively contributing to the operational needs of the school. 

Qualifications and Experience:
French language teaching qualification.
At least two years of experience as a teacher. 
Preferred experience with IB programmes, MYP or PYP.
Excellent communication skills in English, at a native speaker level.
The ability to establish rapport with adults and students. 
The ability to work effectively in a team.
The ability to function effectively under pressure. 
The ability to show initiative and work independently. 
A pleasant and friendly personality.

Experience working with students from diverse cultures and countries would be an advantage. In addition, there may be a possibility to increase the employment percentage if a candidate can teach other subjects and take on other responsibilities. 

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check for the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.
What we offer:
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our locations in central Stockholm are easily accessible by public transportation.
Contract:
Employment Type: Parental Leave Replacement
Part-time, 80 %.
Start: January 7th, 2027
End: February 27th, 2027
Salary: Salary scale
Application:
Please email a short statement of interest as well as a current CV to: application@intsch.se. Mark the email with “French teacher Cover 80%”. We only accept applications in English and from qualified teachers. 
Applications will no longer be accepted after November 20th.
SIS reserves the right to close the application process when a suitable candidate is found.

I denna roll kommer du att vara en viktig del av vår dagliga verksamhet och säkerställa att skolans lokaler och miljö håller högsta standard för både elever och personal.

- Ansvara för och sköta om larmet, passersystemet och taggar för säker tillgång till skolans lokaler.

- Vara en samordnande kontakt mellan skolan, hyresvärden och andra externa instanser som rör skolans byggnader och anläggningar.
- Utföra mindre vaktmästaruppgifter som underhåll, reparationer och uppsikt av lokaler.
- Värna om vår fina skolgård, säkerställa att den hålls ren och inbjudande.
- Förebygga och lösa praktiska problem som uppstår inom skolans fastigheter och lokaler.

Vi söker dig som:

- Har erfarenhet av arbete inom fastighetsförvaltning eller liknande roller, gärna med vaktmästaruppgifter.
- Är tekniskt kunnig, särskilt vad gäller passersystem och brandskydd. Meriterande är om du har genomgått utbildningen för anläggningsskötare. 
- Är organiserad och har förmågan att samarbeta med både interna och externa aktörer.
- Har en god känsla för skolans behov och trivs med att arbeta i en dynamisk och social miljö.
- Är ansvarstagande och noggrann, och har en passion för att vårda vår skolmiljö.

Vi erbjuder:

- En varierande och ansvarsfull roll i en trivsam skolmiljö.
- Möjlighet att vara en central del av skolans arbetslag och bidra till ett positivt arbetsklimat.

Arbeta på en skola med engagerad personal och fantastiska elever.Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 100% med provanställning. För mer information om vår skola, vänligen sewww.osteraker.engelska.se Vi ser fram emot din ansökan via IES Careers. jobs.occupation: Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) Online game presenter Malta!
jobs.description:
Do you want to get away from the dark winter in Sweden or cold part of europe? Here is your chance!!
Are you service-minded and want to work abroad?
Are you passionate about being on camera?
Do you want to become the star of your own Game Show?

We are looking for Game Presenters who want to work in a fast-paced and international work environment for our studio in Malta. As a Game Presenter, you will spend most of your working day in front of the camera leading the game and interacting with the players. The job will help you grow your presentation techniques and your ability to multitask. As a Game Presenter / Host, you will take presenting to an entirely different level. You will be engaging in bubbly, robust, and interactive conversations with your players on the table, taking player experience to new heights, not just through your energy and personality but also your ability to entertain.

We do not require any specific previous work experience, but we want you to have worked at least part-time for a year or two, preferably with service-related tasks. We also require that you are fluent in the Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) language and that you have a conversational level of English. You will spend the first three weeks of your employment with us in our Academy where you will be taught how to lead a game of Blackjack and Roulette as well as how to act in front of the camera.

Apart from a work experience that can give you valuable professional skills for a future career, moving to Malta to work for us provides you with an opportunity for personal growth. For many of our team members in Malta, this is their first experience of living abroad on their own. In addition, we broadcast in 18 languages from our Malta studio and there are more than 40 different nationalities in our teams, so the work environment we offer in Malta is truly dynamic and international.

We offer you:
Relocation package (flight and accommodation for the first 20 nights - if applicable)
Monthly bonuses; based on performance, team player attitude and loyalty
Up to 3 weeks of training in our Academy
Free Gym Membership
Workshops in things like; make-up, healthy living, presentation skills and industry knowledge
Night shift taxi drop off service

Qualifications

To apply you need to be:
Fluent in Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish), working knowledge of English is essential
Service-minded with good communications skills
A fast-learner
A flexible team player
Professional, mature and with a natural ability to follow work rules
An entertainer at heart
Excellent customer service skills
Manage Player expectations and behavior
Minimum 18 years old

Please note that you need to have valid travel documents and that we will ask you to provide a valid Police Conduct Certificate and a written statement from your last employer.
Send your CV to viktorrecruit@gmail.com

Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

At Web Manuals, we’re redefining aviation with our state-of-the-art SaaS solutions.
Our mission?
To revolutionize how aviation professionals work while reaching new heights of innovation and service. As a bootstrapped company, we chart our own course, breaking barriers and setting our sights on the stars and beyond. With offices in Malmö (HQ), San Diego, New York, Singapore, Sydney and Barcelona, we are proud to offer an environment where you can soar, both professionally and personally, and explore a world of opportunities within an international team. Now, we are on the hunt for a Quality Coordinator to join our team in Malmö!
Take the leap and join Web Manuals on our journey to revolutionize aviation – apply today!
About the role
As Quality Coordinator at Web Manuals, you will work with our quality management system and help build a growth-enabled business based on continuous improvement. You will also play a leading role in our planned ISO 14001 implementation, helping us extend our management system into environmental management. Beyond quality, you will govern the full lifecycle of our supplier contracts, from evaluations and audits to negotiations and keeping our contract repository up to date. You will be the go-to person in the organization for supplier contract matters.
You will report to our General Counsel and work closely with our Information Security Specialist in the Legal & Compliance Team. Together you will manage audits and compliance reporting, and you will support our ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2 audits. You’ll also support our Commercial and Customer Success teams in answering RFP questionnaires where applicable. You will be the main contact for our certification body, customers and suppliers on quality matters, so clear communication and a collaborative approach will be key.
Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Ensuring compliance with ISO 9001.
Leading our planned ISO 14001 implementation, from gap analysis to certification.
Managing the Deviation Report Process, including following up on analysis and corrective and preventive actions.
Planning and conducting internal audits and management reviews, and managing customer and supplier audits.
Driving continuous improvement of our Management System, and publishing revisions of the Management System Manual.
Preparing monthly compliance reports, and contributing to our Annual Compliance Report.
Managing supplier contracts throughout their lifecycle, and keeping our Supplier CLM up to date.
Holding recurring quality meetings and training to build awareness of quality, the environment and supplier governance across the company.

What we’re looking for:
Post-secondary degree within a relevant field.
Previous experience with quality management or a similar role.
Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and the principles of management systems.

To thrive in this role, we believe that you have:
A structured, detail-oriented approach, and you’re comfortable maintaining controlled documents.
The ability to engage colleagues across the company in quality and continuous improvement.
Clear and professional communication skills in English, both spoken and written, as English is our corporate language.

Ideally but not required, you also have:
Experience from the SaaS and/or aviation industries.
Experience from auditing or contract management.
Experience from work or studies in an international environment.
A curiosity about environmental management and sustainability.

Other information
Start date: January/February
Location: Malmö
Work extent: Full-time, permanent

Ehra Talent Solutions · Kalmar · Consultant assignment, with openness to permanent employment

With 60 colleagues across five countries, Sweden, Norway, Latvia, the UK, and the Netherlands, we are united by a single mission: helping our clients create the world’s best workplaces. https://ehratalentsolutions.com/
The role
You will lead implementations of our learning and talent management solutions for mid-sized and large organisations in the Nordic private and public sectors. Projects range from 200 to 1,000 hours, and you will typically run 2–5 in parallel. They include new implementations, migrations from other platforms, and expansions with new modules or business units. Your key objective is transparency and predictability, so that customers get what was agreed, on time and within budget.

Support Sales in presales and scoping by clarifying requirements and estimating hours, resources and timeline, so that what is sold can be delivered
Plan, lead and follow up projects covering workshops, configuration, integrations (HR systems, SSO), data migration, testing, training and go-live
Lead a cross-functional team of solution consultants, integration specialists and partner resources, as well as the customer’s own project team
Manage scope and change requests and keep time reporting and invoicing aligned with the contract

Contribute to developing our delivery methodology

Experience managing scope, hour-based budgets and change requests with external customers
Fluent Swedish and confident English, written and spoken, as you will work with customers and partners in both languages

Experience from LMS, HR or talent management systems
Understanding of integrations, SSO and data migration

jobs.description:

Our operations cover the Skåne region and the Greater Copenhagen area, and our office is centrally located at Gustav Adolfs Torg in Malmö.
 
Cost Accounting Manager for an international company – south of Malmö

Are you a skilled finance executive? Would you like to take on a key role in a small and rapidly expanding manufacturing company? Do you also have an eye for details and do you like the idea of products being manufactured in Sweden and sold worldwide? Then this could be your next opportunity!
Our client is an independent Swedish business unit (turn-over 150 MSEK) operating in an international business structure who develops and manufactures at their Swedish site in the Trelleborg area. The company is currently in an exciting development phase and is now looking for a Finance Manager who can take on responsibility for the finance function in Sweden.
This is a broad and hands-on finance management role: you will run the month-end close and personally prepare project costing, over-time revenue recognition, inventory valuation, reconciliations and the Group reporting package, supervising one Finance Assistant. The role works day-to-day with the MD and Project Managers to keep project costs and margins accurate. You will play a key role in supporting the business with financial insight, investment analysis, and decision-making support that drives performance and long-term development.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Own the month-end, quarter-end and year-end close
Deliver reliable financial reports and monitor results over time
Lead the budget and forecast work and analyse the company’s finances
Plan liquidity and optimise working capital
Oversee accounting for projects, stock and production costs
Produce analyses, investment proposals and data that support management decisions
Make sure the company follows accounting rules, tax law and internal control requirements
Improve and build out finance processes, procedures and systems

Your Profile:
You have a relevant degree in e.g. business administration, finance, or accounting and several years of experience in the field. You have strong communication skills in both Swedish and English, written and spoken. Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP systems (preferably Microsoft Dynamics BC) is essential.
You have a good understanding of US GAAP and Swedish statutory requirements. Experience from manufacturing or project-based industry is an advantage, as well as experience in a multinational group environment with cross-border reporting responsibilities. Experience in a leadership role is a plus.
As a person, you are a self-starter with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet demanding deadlines. You thrive in a dynamic environment where you can combine strategic thinking with practical implementation. You have a high level of integrity and are a good communicator with excellent leadership skills.
 
About the Position:
This is a permanent position starting as soon as possible. The role is based south of Malmö.
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application in English as soon as possible via the application link. For more information about the role, please contact Karin Dahlin, Standby Workteam, +46 733 76 39 88.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Svensklärare åk 6–9, vikariat 80 %

Har du ett engagemang för undervisning och en vilja att inspirera unga människor att utvecklas? Brinner du för språk, kommunikation och litteratur och vill väcka elevernas intresse för det svenska språket? Då kan du vara den vi söker!

Internationella Engelska Skolan Årsta söker nu en engagerad svensklärare för ett tidsbegränsat vikariat under vårterminen, då en av våra ordinarie lärare går på föräldraledighet.

Om IES Årsta

Internationella Engelska Skolan Årsta är en grundskola för årskurs 4–9 med cirka 440 elever och 60 medarbetare. Vi är stolta över vår internationella gemenskap och den mångfald som präglar vår verksamhet. Hos oss står höga akademiska förväntningar, trygghet och respekt i centrum. Vi arbetar tillsammans för att skapa en skolmiljö där både elever och medarbetare ges möjlighet att utvecklas och nå sin fulla potential.

Skolan ligger i Årsta med goda kommunikationer till både Gullmarsplan och Årstaberg.

Mer information om IES och våra skolor hittar du på www.engelska.se.

Om tjänsten

Vi söker en engagerad svensklärare som vill ta över undervisningen i svenska för elever i årskurs 6–9 under vårterminen. Tjänsten är ett vikariat på 80 % med anledning av föräldraledighet.

I rollen ansvarar du för att planera, genomföra och följa upp undervisningen samt skapa goda förutsättningar för elevernas lärande och språkutveckling. Du blir en del av ett kollegialt sammanhang där samarbete, tydlig kommunikation och ett gemensamt ansvar för elevernas skolgång är viktiga delar av vardagen. Mentorskap är också en del av rollen.

Vi söker dig som

- Har ett genuint intresse för undervisning och ungdomars utveckling.
- Brinner för det svenska språket och vill inspirera elever till att utveckla sin läsning, skrivning och kommunikativa förmåga.
- Är trygg i ditt ledarskap och kan skapa struktur, tydlighet och studiero i klassrummet.
- Har förmåga att planera och genomföra engagerande undervisning.
- Är relationsskapande och har lätt för att samarbeta med både elever och kollegor.
- Är ansvarstagande, flexibel och tar egna initiativ.
- Delar vår övertygelse om vikten av höga akademiska förväntningar och en trygg skolmiljö.

Lärarlegitimation med behörighet i svenska är meriterande. Vi välkomnar även ansökningar från dig som har relevant ämneskompetens och erfarenhet av undervisning. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Låter detta som en tjänst för dig? Vi ser fram emot att ta del av din ansökan!

Ansök via IES Careers. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post.

För att arbeta inom skolan behöver du kunna visa upp ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret som inte är äldre än sex månader.

Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta recruitment.arsta@engelska.se.

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.
